description: Windows toast notifications for WSL and scripts: buttons that run commands, progress bars, and a drop-in notify-send
notes: toastback registered itself in %LOCALAPPDATA%\toastback and wrote its WSL shim to the default distro.
Check it with `toastback-cli doctor`; see https://github.com/gergodrazsdik/toastback#install for other distros.
pre_uninstall: # `scoop update` runs this too: only `scoop uninstall` removes the installation, so updates keep its settings
